# @hyeonse/design-system

Installed package version: 0.2.0

## Setup

- Import @hyeonse/design-system/tokens.css before @hyeonse/design-system/components.css, once each.
- Run preferenceScript or createPreferenceScript(...) in the document head before CSS paints; match storageKey and defaults with PreferencesProvider.
- Import JavaScript from @hyeonse/design-system/preferences and React APIs from @hyeonse/design-system/react. Do not import internal src/ or dist/ paths.
- Provide DM Sans and Noto Sans KR font assets in the consuming app if those faces are needed; the package only declares a font stack.

## Provided

- Role tokens in tokens.css and styles for ThemeToggle and PreferencesPanel in components.css.
- Preference validation, first-paint script, provider, hook, and display-setting controls.

## Not provided

- General Button, Input, or page-layout React components.
- Font files for consuming applications; provide fonts with the required character coverage separately.
- A design-token interchange format such as DTCG.

Generated from the package declarations, CSS and authored usage metadata. Do not edit this output.

# API

## preferencesKey

Default localStorage key: hyeonse-site-preferences.

Kind: utility · Import: `@hyeonse/design-system/preferences`

```typescript
export declare const preferencesKey = "hyeonse-site-preferences";
```

### Usage

- Pass the same key to createPreferenceScript and PreferencesProvider when overriding it.

Examples: `hds example display-settings`

## defaultPreferences

Default choices: system theme, cobalt accent, comfortable density, crisp corners, full motion.

Kind: utility · Import: `@hyeonse/design-system/preferences`

```typescript
export declare const defaultPreferences: Preferences;
```

### Usage

- Use as the baseline when no valid stored choice or site default exists.

### States

- system
- cobalt
- comfortable
- crisp
- full

### Limits

- This constant does not include site-specific defaults.

Examples: `hds example display-settings`

## validatePreferences

Validate each preference against the allowed choices.

Kind: utility · Import: `@hyeonse/design-system/preferences`

```typescript
export declare function validatePreferences(value: unknown, defaults?: Partial<Preferences>): Preferences;
```

### Usage

- A valid stored field wins; missing or invalid fields use valid site defaults, then defaultPreferences.

### States

- system/light/dark
- cobalt/forest/coral
- comfortable/compact
- crisp/soft
- full/reduced

### Limits

- Non-object and array inputs are treated as empty preferences.

Examples: `hds example display-settings`

## parsePreferences

Parse and validate a stored JSON preference string.

Kind: utility · Import: `@hyeonse/design-system/preferences`

```typescript
export declare function parsePreferences(raw: string | null, defaults?: Partial<Preferences>): Preferences;
```

### Usage

- Malformed JSON and null fall back through validatePreferences with optional site defaults.

Examples: `hds example display-settings`

## serializePreferences

Serialize validated preferences to JSON.

Kind: utility · Import: `@hyeonse/design-system/preferences`

```typescript
export declare function serializePreferences(value: Preferences): string;
```

### Usage

- Invalid fields fall back to package defaults before serialization.

### Limits

- This function does not accept site-specific defaults.

Examples: `hds example display-settings`

## resolvedTheme

Resolve system/light/dark to the effective light or dark theme.

Kind: utility · Import: `@hyeonse/design-system/preferences`

```typescript
export declare function resolvedTheme(theme: ThemePreference, systemDark: boolean): 'light' | 'dark';
```

### Usage

- The system choice follows the supplied systemDark boolean.

### States

- light
- dark

Examples: `hds example display-settings`

## effectiveMotion

Resolve the motion choice with the device reduced-motion preference.

Kind: utility · Import: `@hyeonse/design-system/preferences`

```typescript
export declare function effectiveMotion(motion: MotionPreference, systemReduced: boolean): MotionPreference;
```

### Usage

- A true systemReduced value forces reduced even when the stored choice is full.

### States

- full
- reduced

### Accessibility

- Device reduced motion takes precedence.

Examples: `hds example display-settings`

## createPreferenceScript

Create the inline first-paint preference script with optional key and site defaults.

Kind: utility · Import: `@hyeonse/design-system/preferences`

```typescript
export declare function createPreferenceScript(storageKey?: string, defaults?: Partial<Preferences>): string;
```

### Usage

- Insert the result in the document head before CSS paints.
- Pass the same storageKey and defaults to PreferencesProvider.

### States

- Sets data-theme, data-theme-preference, data-accent, data-density, data-corners, and data-motion on the document root.

### Accessibility

- Applies the device reduced-motion preference.

### Limits

- The generated script reads storage and media preferences once; PreferencesProvider handles later changes.

Examples: `hds example display-settings`

## preferenceScript

Ready-made first-paint script using the package key and defaults.

Kind: utility · Import: `@hyeonse/design-system/preferences`

```typescript
export declare const preferenceScript: string;
```

### Usage

- Insert in the document head before CSS paints.

### Accessibility

- Applies the device reduced-motion preference.

### Limits

- Use createPreferenceScript for a different key or site defaults.

Examples: `hds example display-settings`

## PreferencesProvider

Provide display preferences and keep document attributes in sync.

Kind: provider · Import: `@hyeonse/design-system/react`

```typescript
export declare function PreferencesProvider({ children, storageKey, eventName, defaults }: {
    children: ReactNode;
    storageKey?: string;
    eventName?: string;
    defaults?: Partial<Preferences>;
}): import("react").JSX.Element;
```

### Props

- `children`: `ReactNode`
- `storageKey?`: `string`
- `eventName?`: `string`
- `defaults?`: `Partial<Preferences>`

### Usage

- Wrap consumers of usePreferences, ThemeToggle, and PreferencesPanel.
- The defaults prop supplies valid site defaults for missing or invalid stored fields and reset.

### States

- Reads storage on mount; listens for matching-key or cleared storage events and device color/motion changes.
- Updates this tab and dispatches the configured CustomEvent after applying document attributes.

### Accessibility

- The device reduced-motion preference overrides a full-motion choice.

### Limits

- Storage writes may fail; the current tab still updates.
- Server rendering starts with validated defaults before browser storage is read.

Examples: `hds example display-settings`

## usePreferences

Read preferences and the setPreference/resetPreferences actions from context.

Kind: hook · Import: `@hyeonse/design-system/react`

```typescript
export declare function usePreferences(): PreferenceContext;
```

### Usage

- Call inside PreferencesProvider.
- resetPreferences restores the validated site defaults.

### Limits

- Throws when used outside PreferencesProvider.

Examples: `hds example display-settings`

## ThemeToggle

Cycle theme preference through system, light, and dark.

Kind: component · Import: `@hyeonse/design-system/react`

```typescript
export declare function ThemeToggle({ locale }: {
    locale?: Locale;
}): import("react").JSX.Element;
```

### Props

- `locale?`: `Locale`

### Usage

- Render inside PreferencesProvider; locale defaults to ko and also accepts en.
- Import components.css for the provided visual styles.

### States

- system
- light
- dark

### Accessibility

- Native button with a changing accessible label describing current and next modes.

### Limits

- Only theme preference is changed; the effective theme still follows the device in system mode.

Examples: `hds example display-settings`

## PreferencesPanel

Display controls for theme, accent, density, corners, and motion.

Kind: component · Import: `@hyeonse/design-system/react`

```typescript
export declare function PreferencesPanel({ locale }: {
    locale?: Locale;
}): import("react").JSX.Element;
```

### Props

- `locale?`: `Locale`

### Usage

- Render inside PreferencesProvider; locale defaults to ko and also accepts en.
- Import components.css for the provided visual styles.

### States

- system/light/dark
- cobalt/forest/coral
- comfortable/compact
- crisp/soft
- full/reduced

### Accessibility

- Uses fieldset legends, native radio inputs, pressed-state accent buttons, and a live status.

### Limits

- It controls only the provided display preferences.

Examples: `hds example display-settings`

# Type context

## @hyeonse/design-system/preferences

```typescript
export type ThemePreference = 'system' | 'light' | 'dark';
export type AccentPreference = 'cobalt' | 'forest' | 'coral';
export type DensityPreference = 'comfortable' | 'compact';
export type CornersPreference = 'crisp' | 'soft';
export type MotionPreference = 'full' | 'reduced';
export type Preferences = {
    theme: ThemePreference;
    accent: AccentPreference;
    density: DensityPreference;
    corners: CornersPreference;
    motion: MotionPreference;
};
export declare const preferencesKey = "hyeonse-site-preferences";
export declare const defaultPreferences: Preferences;
export declare function validatePreferences(value: unknown, defaults?: Partial<Preferences>): Preferences;
export declare function parsePreferences(raw: string | null, defaults?: Partial<Preferences>): Preferences;
export declare function serializePreferences(value: Preferences): string;
export declare function resolvedTheme(theme: ThemePreference, systemDark: boolean): 'light' | 'dark';
export declare function effectiveMotion(motion: MotionPreference, systemReduced: boolean): MotionPreference;
export declare function createPreferenceScript(storageKey?: string, defaults?: Partial<Preferences>): string;
export declare const preferenceScript: string;
```

## @hyeonse/design-system/react

```typescript
import type { ReactNode } from 'react';
import type { Preferences } from './preferences.js';
export type Locale = 'ko' | 'en';
type PreferenceContext = {
    preferences: Preferences;
    setPreference: <K extends keyof Preferences>(key: K, value: Preferences[K]) => void;
    resetPreferences: () => void;
};
export declare function PreferencesProvider({ children, storageKey, eventName, defaults }: {
    children: ReactNode;
    storageKey?: string;
    eventName?: string;
    defaults?: Partial<Preferences>;
}): import("react").JSX.Element;
export declare function usePreferences(): PreferenceContext;
export declare function ThemeToggle({ locale }: {
    locale?: Locale;
}): import("react").JSX.Element;
export declare function PreferencesPanel({ locale }: {
    locale?: Locale;
}): import("react").JSX.Element;
export {};
```

# CSS tokens

Values are CSS expressions, with their original selector and media-query conditions. This is the package catalog format, not a DTCG token interchange file.

## --ink

Primary foreground text

Default: `#101114`

- `:root[data-theme='dark']` → `#f2f4f8`
- @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) · `:root:not([data-theme])` → `#f2f4f8`

## --paper

Page background

Default: `#ffffff`

- `:root[data-theme='dark']` → `#111318`
- @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) · `:root:not([data-theme])` → `#111318`

## --muted

Secondary text

Default: `#5a606b`

- `:root[data-theme='dark']` → `#b2b8c4`
- @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) · `:root:not([data-theme])` → `#b2b8c4`

## --line

Subtle dividing line

Default: `#d8dbe3`

- `:root[data-theme='dark']` → `#444a56`
- @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) · `:root:not([data-theme])` → `#444a56`

## --surface

Grouped content surface

Default: `#f3f5f8`

- `:root[data-theme='dark']` → `#1c2028`
- @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) · `:root:not([data-theme])` → `#1c2028`

## --surface-raised

Raised content surface

Default: `#ffffff`

- `:root[data-theme='dark']` → `#282d37`
- @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) · `:root:not([data-theme])` → `#282d37`

## --accent-solid

Solid accent surface

Default: `#204cfc`

- `:root[data-accent='forest']` → `#087451`
- `:root[data-accent='coral']` → `#b93d20`

## --accent-text

Accent text, link, selection, and focus

Default: `#204cfc`

- `:root[data-accent='forest']` → `#087451`
- `:root[data-accent='coral']` → `#b93d20`
- `:root[data-theme='dark']` → `#9aafff`
- `:root[data-theme='dark'][data-accent='forest']` → `#68dfb1`
- `:root[data-theme='dark'][data-accent='coral']` → `#ffa58e`
- @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) · `:root:not([data-theme])` → `#9aafff`

## --palette-cobalt

Cobalt palette reference

Default: `#204cfc`

## --palette-forest

Forest palette reference

Default: `#087451`

## --palette-coral

Coral palette reference

Default: `#b93d20`

## --on-accent

Foreground on solid accent surface

Default: `#ffffff`

## --blue

Alias of accent text

Default: `var(--accent-text)`

## --about-surface

About section surface

Default: `var(--accent-solid)`

- `:root[data-theme='dark']` → `#1b2540`
- `:root[data-theme='dark'][data-accent='forest']` → `#173029`
- `:root[data-theme='dark'][data-accent='coral']` → `#35231f`
- @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) · `:root:not([data-theme])` → `#1b2540`

## --about-ink

About section primary text

Default: `#ffffff`

- `:root[data-theme='dark']` → `#f5f7ff`
- @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) · `:root:not([data-theme])` → `#f5f7ff`

## --about-muted

About section secondary text

Default: `#dce3ff`

- `:root[data-accent='forest']` → `#d4f5e8`
- `:root[data-accent='coral']` → `#ffe1d9`
- `:root[data-theme='dark']` → `#c1c9de`
- `:root[data-theme='dark'][data-accent='forest']` → `#b7e1d1`
- `:root[data-theme='dark'][data-accent='coral']` → `#e7c1b8`
- @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) · `:root:not([data-theme])` → `#c1c9de`

## --inverse-surface

Inverse panel surface

Default: `#101114`

- `:root[data-theme='dark']` → `#f2f4f8`
- @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) · `:root:not([data-theme])` → `#f2f4f8`

## --inverse-ink

Text on inverse panel

Default: `#ffffff`

- `:root[data-theme='dark']` → `#101114`
- @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) · `:root:not([data-theme])` → `#101114`

## --radius-card

Card corner radius

Default: `0px`

- `:root[data-corners='soft']` → `20px`

## --radius-control

Control corner radius

Default: `2px`

- `:root[data-corners='soft']` → `12px`

## --space-factor

Multiplier used by compact spacing

Default: `1`

- `:root[data-density='compact']` → `.8`

## --font-sans

Sans-serif font stack; font files are supplied by the app

Default: `'DM Sans', 'Noto Sans KR', sans-serif`

## --gutter

Responsive page gutter

Default: `clamp(22px, 4.1vw, 72px)`

- @media (max-width: 700px) · `:root` → `22px`

## --control-min-size

Minimum control size

Default: `44px`

## --text-control

Control text size

Default: `12px`

# Examples

## display-settings

React display settings with first-paint preferences and public imports.

### examples/preferences.ts

```typescript
import { createPreferenceScript } from '@hyeonse/design-system/preferences';
import type { Preferences } from '@hyeonse/design-system/preferences';

// Share these values between the document head and the client Provider.
export const storageKey = 'example-display-preferences';
export const siteDefaults = { corners: 'soft' } satisfies Partial<Preferences>;
export const initialPreferenceScript = createPreferenceScript(storageKey, siteDefaults);

// Insert initialPreferenceScript in a <script> in the document head before CSS.
// Use your framework's script/HTML API; do not concatenate user input into HTML.
```

### examples/display-settings.tsx

```tsx
'use client';

import { PreferencesPanel, PreferencesProvider, ThemeToggle, usePreferences } from '@hyeonse/design-system/react';
import '@hyeonse/design-system/tokens.css';
import '@hyeonse/design-system/components.css';
import { siteDefaults, storageKey } from './preferences.js';

function ReadingPreference() {
  const { preferences, setPreference } = usePreferences();
  return <label>
    <input type="checkbox" checked={preferences.motion === 'reduced'}
      onChange={event => setPreference('motion', event.target.checked ? 'reduced' : 'full')} />
    움직임 줄이기
  </label>;
}

export function DisplaySettings() {
  return <PreferencesProvider storageKey={storageKey} defaults={siteDefaults}>
    <ThemeToggle locale="ko" />
    <PreferencesPanel locale="ko" />
    <ReadingPreference />
  </PreferencesProvider>;
}
```

## token-card

HTML card styled with public role tokens.

### examples/token-card.css

```css
/* App-owned markup/styles: the package does not export a Card component. */
.example-card {
  box-sizing: border-box;
  max-width: 42rem;
  padding: calc(24px * var(--space-factor));
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: var(--radius-card);
  background: var(--surface);
  color: var(--ink);
  font-family: var(--font-sans);
  line-height: 1.7;
}
.example-card h2 { margin: 0 0 .5em; }
.example-card p { color: var(--muted); }
.example-card a { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: var(--control-min-size); color: var(--accent-text); text-underline-offset: .2em; }
.example-card a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent-text); outline-offset: 3px; }
```

### examples/token-card.html

```html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="ko">
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
    <title>역할 토큰으로 만든 카드</title>
    <!-- These relative paths run in the repository or unpacked package. -->
    <!-- In a bundler, import @hyeonse/design-system/tokens.css instead. -->
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../dist/tokens.css">
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="./token-card.css">
  </head>
  <body>
    <main>
      <article class="example-card" aria-labelledby="card-title">
        <h2 id="card-title">읽기 편한 화면 만들기</h2>
        <p>본문, 보조 글자, 링크에 서로 다른 역할 토큰을 사용합니다.</p>
        <a href="../docs/foundations.md">기초 규칙 읽기</a>
      </article>
    </main>
  </body>
</html>
```
